title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming & structured output
author: Amelia Park
description: This PR implements parity for the OpenAI /v1/chat.completions surface across parameters, role handling, stop sequences/logprobs, streaming stability, function/tool calling deltas, and structured output formatting. Motivation: customers using the OpenAI compatibility layer expect identical behaviour for common parameters (temperature, top_p, n, presence/ frequency_penalty), role metadata in both streaming and non-streaming responses, correct handling of stop sequences when prefix tokens are present, and availability of token logprobs in non-streaming responses. The change set includes: request param mapping and validation; a streaming delta encoder that preserves role and function call fragments; stop-sequence detection in the streaming runtime to trigger graceful close; support for returning logprobs for non-streaming completions; improved structured output formatting to match OpenAI's assistant/content/role conventions; comprehensive unit and integration tests; docs and migration notes. Checklist: [x] param mapping implemented; [x] role metadata preserved in streaming deltas; [x] stop sequence handling in streaming and non-streaming; [x] logprobs for non-streaming; [x] structured output formatting and examples; [x] tests added and CI green. Breaking changes/notes: the default streaming chunk boundary behaviour was tightened to avoid partial stop-token leaks; see migration notes in docs/openai_compat.md.
commits: squash: add openai chat.completions param mapping and validation
fix(streaming): preserve role metadata and function_call fragments in deltas
feat(stop): detect stop sequences in-stream and close generator gracefully
feat(logprobs): expose token logprobs for non-streaming completions behind flag
test: add compat tests for roles, stop sequences, logprobs and response formatting
docs: update OpenAI compatibility guide and migration notes
review_comments: Rajat Singh: Can you spell out how we handle conflicting stop sequences when prefix caching is present? The current implementation checks suffix matches but I want to ensure no race with KV cache flushing.

Amelia Park: We added a stop_detector that accounts for cached prefixes by normalizing the last N generated tokens against active stop sequences; it emits a close event only when a full stop sequence is observed in the concatenated stream. Added unit tests to cover prefix+caching scenarios.
Marta Lopez: Minor nit: the param validation code duplicates logic in services/compat/openai/validate.go; can we centralize?
Amelia Park: Pulled validation into services/compat/openai/params.go and updated callers. PTAL.
Evan Chen: CI flakes observed on streaming handler tests due to timing; suggest increasing the generator timeout in tests rather than removing assertions.
Amelia Park: Increased test timeouts and added deterministic pseudo-random seed to the streaming test harness to avoid flakiness.
release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: mapped request parameters (temperature, top_p, n, penalties), preserved roles in streaming deltas and non-streaming responses, stop sequence detection in streaming and non-streaming paths, optional token logprobs for non-streaming completions, improved structured output formatting to match OpenAI assistant role/content conventions. See docs/migrations/openai_chat_parity.md for migration steps and compatibility flags.
